shortBulletSummary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index currently reflects a Neutral sentiment among investors.
Several altcoins, including AVAX, ADA, LINK, RENDER, and FET, experienced significant price surges.
The SEC granted a 5-year exemption for tokenized stock trading, and the CFTC provided relief to crypto developers.
Bitcoin maintained its position above $76,000 following a Federal Reserve rate hike, though some demand signals softened.
An attack on an Ethereum Safe multisig wallet resulted in a loss of $7.73 million in rsETH.
